properties.description:
Cut 2026-10-29 on Anthony's word ("prepare the 0.94.0 release"), in PR release/v0.94.0 (#814). The tag push stays his. A minor carrying:
- #813 (increment 2 of epoch:planned-cognition-plus-memory): every string under a reply's loop_hint/hint/next/nudge/next_step naming a served tool or skill gets an id `<field>/<named call>` in the reply's _meta["reflow2/cues"] and a `cues` field on its usage-ledger line; a stdio/HTTP handshake writes a kind:"cue" ledger line offering instructions/graph_report_markdown and instructions/search_design; usage_report's tally gains a `cues` block (offered, followed within 5, followed at all, unattributable); the connect-time instructions carry the first-read cue (cues::FIRST_READ_CUE) and both SessionStart texts in tools/loop_nudge.py carry it, replacing "call open_questions" as the first step; search_design hits with an empty name gain `excerpt` (at most 160 characters).
- #815 (taken in before the release shipped): add_decision (proposed) and replace_text offer set_decision_status unless the caller is KNOWN (writes_for, or named by the gateway or bearer token) and is not the owner, who then gets "a question for the owner" (ask_question); locally with no name, and on every --call, set_decision_status is offered as in 0.93.1; behind a gateway an unnamed caller gets ask_question. get_instructions step 0a and the VS Code route's "Start of a session" name graph_report_markdown first; AGENTS.md's re-bless command is corrected.

Measured against the published 0.93.1 binary (linux-x86_64 archive sha256 bbf0ee12..., checked against checksums.txt), over stdio on a fresh store, on a build of the merged branch: 199 tools on both, none added or removed; one differs, search_design, in its output schema only (gains `excerpt`); toolsnap: all 199 match. Skills 35, every get_skill reply and list_skills byte-equal. get_instructions differs in step 0a only (35,921 -> 36,288 bytes); describe_schema identical. The initialize instructions gain the first-read sentence (9,677 -> 9,961 characters). Nothing deprecated or removed. The schema stamp does not move (28 node, 69 edge types), so no upgrade doc is owed. In the --call setup (checked on that build): ledger lines carry cues and --call usage_report shows the cues block; the door writes no kind:"cue" line; add_decision offers set_decision_status; search_design shows the excerpt. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.name: v0.94.0 — cues carry ids and are counted, the first read is named before the first call, a settling cue goes to the owner, and a nameless search hit shows an excerpt
